additional_analytical_decisions: Distinguish business-combination consideration from asset-acquisition cost and cash paid, separate cash compensation embedded in a transaction, and connect those classifications to company operating and investing cash without counting the same payment twice. Compare revenue on a disclosed acquisition/divestiture perimeter while keeping an explicitly limited earnings diagnostic separate.
reference_method: Executable economic model with a separate derivation, valid alternative SQL and financial invariant checks

controls.name: compensation_classification
controls.rationale: A greater portion of unchanged closing cash settles unvested service awards. Investing cash and asset cost fall as operating compensation rises. Total cash and immediate expense remain unchanged.

controls.name: acquired_cash
controls.rationale: More acquired cash offsets goodwill and reduces net investing cash without changing consideration.

controls.name: accrued_transaction_cost
controls.rationale: Additional unpaid acquisition costs are allocated to IPRD and expensed. They change cost and earnings, with no new cash payment.

controls.name: share_valuation
controls.rationale: A higher closing value for issued shares raises consideration and goodwill but not closing cash.

controls.name: noncash_remeasurement
controls.rationale: A smaller noncash fair-value gain reduces reported earnings while the selected-effects diagnostic and cash remain invariant.

controls.name: reported_total
controls.rationale: An independent source-total discrepancy must remain visible in the stated residual.

controls.name: preacquisition_revenue
controls.rationale: Additional prior-year target revenue before the actual acquisition date changes the pro forma comparator without changing statutory BMS revenue.

controls.name: current_revenue
controls.rationale: Incremental zero-margin current-year sales change both revenue comparisons while pretax earnings and cash are unchanged.

controls.name: monetary_scale
controls.rationale: Scale all monetary observations together. Growth percentages remain invariant.

controls.name: row_order
controls.rationale: Input row order has no financial meaning.

source_review: Primary source headings, definitions and factual values inspected. Independent human review remains pending.
model_exposure: No candidate trials before initial freeze. Source groups are separate from development tasks. Published references remain a contamination risk.
execution: Baseline task resources and frozen scorer reused. Qualified GLM uses 3600 seconds and 24 turns. Native Sol uses 3600 seconds and has no equivalent turn cap.
